events.title: UMC says 2027 foundry price adjustments could be broader and more pronounced if tight supply-demand persists
events.observed_evidence: Economic Daily reported UMC saying recent order conditions are positive and that, if the current supply-demand trend persists, the magnitude and breadth of wafer-foundry price adjustments in 2027 would be more evident than in 2H26. The same report says UMC expects current-quarter wafer shipments to rise by a high-single-digit percentage sequentially, utilization to exceed 90%, and gross margin to remain in the mid-30% range, with 8-inch demand improving for PMIC, sensors and MCUs. UMC had already announced 2H26 pricing actions earlier in 2026; this event records only the incremental 2027 breadth/magnitude signal.
events.semantic_interpretation: This is incremental evidence that mature-node pricing power may persist into 2027 rather than being limited to the already-known 2H26 increase. AI infrastructure demand for PMIC/control/sensing components is a plausible transmission channel, but no unreported price-increase percentage, revenue uplift, EPS uplift or margin uplift is inferred.

deduplication.material_delta: 2027 pricing adjustment breadth/magnitude signal; prior public evidence already covered 2H26 price increases
